assets.usage: Website preview generated from diagram 1 in solution.tex; editable source remains inline in solution.tex.

diagram_previews.alt: Circles omega1 (centre O1) and omega2 (centre O2) meeting at A and B, the vertical line AB, and the circle omega with centre O externally tangent to both; line AB cuts omega at P and at Q (just above A), the dashed radii OP and OQ form a 120 degree angle, and the red perpendicular from O to the line has length r/2.

difficulty_rationale: The key insight is to compute the distance from the third centre to the common chord as a difference of powers; after that the answer follows in two lines.
